title: Eager to learn about the Neurodegenerative Disease Knowledge Portal?
summary: This video introduces the Neurodegenerative Disease Knowledge Portal which is developed by the Broad Institute in collaboration with the Montreal Neurological Institute-Hospital and the Global Parkinson’s Genetics Program.
